prompt: Original generic modular ground-shell; one separable asset, not a whole environment. No real place/person, brands, logos, visible text, sci-fi, low-poly filler, floating parts or intersecting geometry. Physically plausible PBR, believable wear, correct UVs/normals; meter scale, +Y up, reusable grounded pivot. Clear 2 m walkway through forecourt to shop; pumps are non-interactive. No fuel handling, live pricing, traffic motion, brand logos, or inferred place names. Target bounding dimensions 24m wide x 0.3m high x 20m deep. Materials: concrete-weathered. Clear passage where applicable; no arms/hands, forced characters or inaccessible hazards. GLB with embedded PBR textures. Generic exploration candidate only; visual/rights review required.
